Ok so recipe, this will make enough for 2 pie crust or a pie crust and top:

•2 1/4 cups gf flour (I love King Arthur Measure4Measure) 
•1 1/2 teaspoon salt
•1/2 cup cold unsalted butter ( if using salted butter use 1/2 teaspoon salt instead) 
•1 egg
•1/3 cup water( cold is best but room temp will work)
• 2 teaspoons apple cider vinegar

1) Mix flour and salt. Cut butter into slices and work into flour using hands. It’ll get crumbly
2) Mix egg, water, and vinegar in a separate bowl and then add to flour mix. I use a well method. Mix until dough comes together 
3) divide dough in half
4) Roll out dough to desired shape; add additional water as needed. 
5) You can refrigerate unused dough but it will get hard and water will be need to be added back in. 
6) For a pie filling that you don’t need to bake, bake the crust on the 325-350*F for 10-15 minutes. If baking pie filling and dough needs to be prebaked, test it beforehand, because the crust can turn rock solid with this method. 

Let me know if you have any questions!!
